title: The Last of the Caravan
openingText: He's been watching you for an hour before he lets you see him: a weathered man in a coat of stitched tarpaulin, crossbow held easy, not quite pointed away. 'Twelve of us came through here. I'm what's left. You want what I know, and I want to not die out here. So. Talk slow, and keep your hands where the light is.'
dialogueWalkaway: Enough. I was doing fine before you, I'll do fine after.
dialogueAccept: Deal. Don't make me regret trusting somebody again.
confidence: Marrow is not going to the next settlement. He wants you to carry the others.

clauses.text: Marrow marks which wells are dry and which route still runs: the country charted, and the fuel the castle would have burned finding out.
He'll split his water cache if you're carrying wounded.
He wants escort to the next settlement: the castle burns its fuel on his road instead of yours.
Where the caravan buried its strongbox before the end: 35 gold in salvage.
Their hide: a place to lie up, and a supply anchor while you use it
You walk them to the next safe place
A spare blade from your armory
